notes.title: SynCo 2321 Dev log & release update
notes.content:
[b]SynCo 2321 Dev log & release information.[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865497/b4f1dbf88408e109325cb452ea823cc2dfd34fb9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865497/8be85c72921085e6627b391461c65ac7764ee590.png[/img][/url]

The official release of SynCo 2321 is growing closer and I wanted to share the news! A firm date is not yet established but should be within the next two weeks.

[h1]"Why hasn't SynCo 2321 already been released?"[/h1]

When SynCo 2321 was added to Steam I wanted to make sure all of the steps required to launch on the platform were completed. This was accomplished but as a requirement Steam asks for a launch date.  While it would be possible to have released the base game at the date selected, it was more important to me that the game have an increased level of content before offering the game to players. As a gamer myself I felt it was important to meet a certain level of playability before opening the development process up by beginning Early Access. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865497/0ccfe11f63fac66fc72e5bf2d9acc6ee0b072d33.png[/img]
[h2]SynCo 2321 version 0.42 dev log[/h2]

It has been a while since an update has been added to Steam for testing.  SynCo 2321 has been going through the ringer to ensure optimization goals are being met. Additional story content has been added but is currently limited to one possible outcome. It is important to note that the story implemented in the game is in draft form and subject to revision.

Rendering optimization of 3d models to improve gameplay stability.

Chapter 1 Act 1 - basic story arc drafted(playable but without meaningful choice options implemented.)
Chapter 1 Act 2 - Kira plot line 70% completed. No love for Russell at this time.
Reduced AI difficulty for Chapter 1 mobs for testing.
Updated 25% of map to improve character motion and interaction with environment.
Introduced new AI mechanics to be used for boss encounter (not accessible to players in 0.42)
Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: SynCo 2321 Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]SynCo 2321 development roadmap[/h1]

I wanted to share with everyone the projected timeline for development. Please note this is subject to being changed. Any changes will be posted. 

[h2]Current stage: Expected completion for initial Early Access launch on Feb 23rd 2022[/h2]

Initialization of base plot points throughout the Ashville map.

Implementation of NPCs involved in story in Ashville.

Creation and implementation of initial dialogue for quest progress.(to be refined and expanded later)

Base implementation of cutscene for Kira(NPC)

General refinements to navmesh & AI for pathing

General Menu system for pregame


[h2]Next stage: Expected completion between April - May 2022[/h2]

Ashville updates to improve upon navigation actions. (ladders, climbable locations, etc)

Initialization of Sector 7 mapping for navigation actions

Implementation of NPC's in environment.

Initialization of sector 7 primary plot quest line (to be refined and expanded later)

notes.title: SynCo 2321 Comes to Steam
notes.content:
[h1]SynCo 2321 Set to launch in February 2022 on Steam for Early Access.[/h1]

SynCo 2321 is a third-person action RPG shooter and is an independent production.  Launching in Early Access will allow players and testers to use the Steam platform to stay up to date and provide players an opportunity to provide feedback.

Early Access is anticipated to last between 10 & 13 months during the ongoing development of SynCo 2321.  Look for a future announcement for more details on The development timeline.

Part of the Steam onboarding process required a lot of custom resolution graphics as well as an approved trailer. Most of these are placeholders and will be updated in the future.
